messages:
Samira: heads-up: publish pipeline blocked because regendiff detected changes in generated SDKs. looks like typegen reordered function params which cascaded into docs/changelog and bumped semver.
Derek: oh no. ordering-only? or actual API surface change?
Samira: ordering-only in OpenAPI traversal -> different parameter order in generated method signatures (Go/TS parity failing). example hunk:
```
- /users/{id}/get: parameters: [role, id]
+ /users/{id}/get: parameters: [id, role]
```
Samira: generator treats param order as stable API surface so changelog generator flagged it as breaking -> minor bump.
Kai: this is the parser traversal being nondeterministic. also saw a flaky integration that toggles default retry.strategy = "exponential" in one test path which mutates generated defaults in typegen output. two noise sources.
lint-bot: regendiff summary: 4 files changed (param ordering), 1 file changed (tests/integration/retry-leak.js). deterministic_hash: false
Derek: short-term: two mitigations: 1) canonicalize parameter ordering in the typegen layer before emitting SDKs, 2) update release gating to treat ordering-only diffs as no-semver. both are low-risk.
Samira: agree. can we also add a small extractor in changelog-generator to ignore reorder-only hunks so we don't spam release notes?
Kai: will open three PRs: typegen canonicalizer, changelog filter, and test fix for retry leak (use a cloned config per test).
Samira: for CI hotfix can you add `--canonicalize-params` to regen step and flip the gating rule? publish window in ~45m.
Derek: pushing a tiny CI patch now: regen job includes `--canonicalize-params`, and release-gate updated to ignore param-order-only diffs. pushed branch devex/regen-canonicalize.
ci-bot: build #77001: regen re-run -> PASSED (no regendiff).
Samira: Kai, plz include a unit that runs regen 10x and asserts identical output to catch nondeterminism.
Kai: will do. PR #9001 opened: test fix, canonicalizer unit, changelog filter. small changelog note included.
lint-bot: PR scan: changelog entry detected; semver impact: none.
Derek: created follow-up ticket DEX-1890 to upstream deterministic traversal in openapi-parser, and DEX-1891 for changelog heuristics.
Samira: docs/update: adding onboarding tip: "If your first-run regen shows diffs, re-run with `yarn regen --canonicalize-params` and open a regendiff ticket if it persists."
ci-bot: build #77005: full pipeline PASSED.
Samira: thanks everyone. leaving thread open until PR merges.
Kai: merged PR #9001, added the 10x determinism test.
Derek: closing after one more stable run.
ci-bot: build #77008: all sample-sdk jobs PASSED.
Samira: closing 8079; great work keeping publish clean
